snippet.title: Lost Castle 2 | MIX Summer Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
"Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters! 

More info on this and other games from the summer showcase here: https://mediaindieexchange.com/showcases/summer-showcase-2025

About The MIX: We organize and produce digital shows, content, and in person game showcases that support game developers and the gaming culture.
